subject: After-action log extract request and IR summary
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@vault-sec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: After-action log extract request and IR summary

Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, BlueWave requested a compact evidence packet so they can close their vendor review. Can you confirm you received the draft post-incident summary I attached and whether the following extracts are sufficient for their security team?

1) Flow log snippets for 10/12–10/13 (redacted IPs)
2) Auth/audit events for the affected service (session IDs only)
3) A short timeline of detection -> containment steps (high level)

I attached a short postmortem draft (redwood_ir_draft.docx) — it’s a summarised version intended for external consumption (no raw PII). If you need more verbatim logs we can provide a manifest and an encrypted bundle; we’ll want to redact customer identifiers first.

Goal: get BlueWave a minimal SIG/CAIQ-friendly snapshot and a secure link to a full evidence bundle for their SOC team by EOD Monday.

Thanks — please flag any objections to the redaction approach.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_ir_draft.docx (draft)
From: Alex Chen <alex@vault-sec.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluewave.com
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: After-action log extract request and IR summary

Naomi —

Received, thanks. The draft looks good as a customer-facing summary. A couple of asks from BlueWave’s SOC: 

- Can you provide the exact time window for the auth events you plan to include? They prefer ISO timestamps.
- We will need a manifest file listing file names + sha256 checksums for any bundled logs.
- Please include a short note describing what was redacted and why (IP hashes, customer IDs).

If possible include a CSV with the first 500 flow-log lines (redacted) for sampling. We can accept an encrypted ZIP via pre-shared S3 bucket. I’m looping in BlueWave security (security@bluewave.com) to confirm their intake method.

I’m attaching a preliminary manifest template (prelim_logs_manifest.txt) — fill in the columns and we can validate checksums on our side.

—Alex
Alex Chen
Director, Vendor Assurance — Vault Security
alex@vault-sec.com
Attachments: prelim_logs_manifest.txt

Linking in engineering on the log export details. Quick notes on capacity and redaction:

- We can export a CSV of flow logs for the 48-hour window 2026-10-12T03:00:00Z through 2026-10-14T03:00:00Z and apply a deterministic hash to IPs and internal hostnames.
- Auth/audit events: we’ll include event_type, timestamp (ISO8601), session_id, outcome. No user identifiers.
- I’m attaching a small sample CSV (aws_flow_logs_snippet.csv) with the redaction approach applied — it’s safe for external review.

Diego, can you prepare the full encrypted bundle and manifest. Naomi, do you want us to include the containment runbook excerpts in the bundle or keep them in the narrative summary only? My recommendation: excerpts only in the narrative (avoid revealing playbook internals).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager — Platform Reliability
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: aws_flow_logs_snippet.csv

Bundle is ready and uploaded to the pre-shared BlueWave S3 bucket as discussed. Details below:

Manifest: IR_evidence_manifest_20261015.csv (checksums included)
Encrypted: AES-256, password exchanged via our secrets channel per contract
Included:

- auth_events_export.csv (ISO timestamps, session IDs only)
- redwood_ir_draft.docx (external summary)
- evidence_readme.txt (redaction notes + procedures)

I’ve also uploaded the manifest and a copy of the bundle to the internal Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/bluewave/ir-1015 (restricted view).

Alex/security@bluewave.com — checksum for the ZIP (sha256): 6a7b9f2c...f1d (full checksum in manifest). Please reply with confirmation once you’ve validated.

Naomi — regarding the containment runbook: we included a 2-paragraph excerpt in the readme that describes actions taken (isolate service, rotate keys, temporary rate-limits). No step-by-step playbook content.

Diego Fernandez
Senior SRE, Serving Runtime
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
